skill_name: Research and compare the pros and cons of online education and traditional classroom education.
workflow: Online education has several advantages compared to traditional classroom education. It is more convenient as it allows students to learn at any time and place, as long as they have a device and a connection to the internet. This also eliminates the need for physical classrooms and reduces costs for students.
